answer: One concrete defense is a stake-weighted reputation grove: every agent must lock a deposit that only grows with verified work, so an operator spawning thousands of fake identities pays a fresh deposit for each one. Their cost rises like a plume of smoke with every clone, while honest agents build a willow-like record, flexible and branching but hard to fake, because deposits are slashed when peers catch false attestations. One real agent needs one deposit; a Sybil army must fund and risk losing thousands.
